description: CBPR+: UETR is mandatory in pacs.003 even though the XSD declares it optional.
errorMessage: UETR (Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference) is mandatory in pacs.003 under CBPR+.
fix: Add a valid UUID v4 to <PmtId><UETR> (e.g., 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267).

description: CBPR+: InstrId and EndToEndId are mandatory in pacs.003 PmtId.
errorMessage: InstrId and EndToEndId are mandatory in pacs.003 PmtId under CBPR+.

description: CBPR+: Debtor is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: Debtor information is mandatory in pacs.003.

description: CBPR+: Creditor is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: Creditor information is mandatory in pacs.003.

description: CBPR+: Debtor Name is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: Debtor Name is mandatory in pacs.003 unless debtor is identified by AnyBIC.
fix: Add <Nm>Sample Name</Nm> as first child of <Dbtr>.

description: CBPR+: Creditor Name is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: Creditor Name is mandatory in pacs.003 unless creditor is identified by AnyBIC.
fix: Add <Nm>Sample Name</Nm> as first child of <Cdtr>.

description: CBPR+: Debtor Account is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: DbtrAcct is mandatory in pacs.003 — every direct debit must reference a debtor account.

description: CBPR+: Creditor Account is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: CdtrAcct is mandatory in pacs.003 — every direct debit must reference a creditor account.

description: CBPR+: ChrgBr (Charge Bearer) is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: ChrgBr (Charge Bearer) is mandatory in pacs.003.
fix: Add <ChrgBr>SLEV</ChrgBr> inside DrctDbtTxInf. CBPR+ direct debits typically use SLEV.

description: CBPR+: MndtRltdInf (Mandate Related Information) is mandatory when DrctDbtTx is present.
errorMessage: MndtRltdInf is mandatory in pacs.003 when DrctDbtTx is present.

description: CBPR+: IntrBkSttlmAmt is mandatory in pacs.003.
errorMessage: IntrBkSttlmAmt (Interbank Settlement Amount) is mandatory in pacs.003.

description: Charges currency must match the Interbank Settlement Amount currency. If ChrgsInf is present, ChrgsInf/Amt/@Ccy must equal IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy.
errorMessage: Charges currency does not match the transaction currency. ChrgsInf/Amt currency does not match IntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
fix: Update ChrgsInf/Amt/@Ccy to match IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy. Example: If IntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy='SEK' but ChrgsInf/Amt Ccy='USD', change ChrgsInf/Amt Ccy to 'SEK'.

description: Exchange rate is mandatory when InstdAmt currency differs from IntrBkSttlmAmt currency. If InstdAmt.Ccy != IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy, then XchgRate must be present.
errorMessage: Invalid message content for exchange rate when instructed amount is present. InstdAmt currency differs from IntrBkSttlmAmt currency but XchgRate is absent.
fix: Insert <XchgRate>{rate}</XchgRate> inside DrctDbtTxInf after InstdAmt when InstdAmt.Ccy differs from IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy. The exchange rate value must be a positive decimal (e.g., 1.1234) with up to 10 fraction digits. Alternatively, if the currencies should be the same, remove InstdAmt element entirely.

description: Exchange rate must NOT be present when InstdAmt currency equals IntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
errorMessage: XchgRate must not be present when InstdAmt currency equals IntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
fix: Remove the <XchgRate> element. XchgRate is only required when currencies differ.

description: ChrgBr must be one of the valid CBPR+ values: SHAR, SLEV, CRED, DEBT.
errorMessage: ChrgBr must be one of: SHAR, SLEV, CRED, DEBT.
fix: Set <ChrgBr> to one of: SHAR, SLEV, CRED, DEBT. CBPR+ direct debits: SLEV recommended.

description: CBPR+: MndtId is mandatory in MndtRltdInf when present.
errorMessage: MndtId is mandatory in MndtRltdInf.

description: CBPR+: DtOfSgntr is mandatory in MndtRltdInf when present.
errorMessage: DtOfSgntr (Date of Signature) is mandatory in MndtRltdInf.

description: If ChrgBr = CRED, ChrgsInf block must be present with Amt and Agt.
errorMessage: When ChrgBr = CRED, ChrgsInf block must be present.

description: If ChrgsInf is present, Agt (Agent Details) must be included.
errorMessage: ChrgsInf is present but the Agt element is absent.

name: PACS003_CreDtTm_Date_Format_Invalid
description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm contains an invalid ISO 8601 datetime. Common errors: 'Z' suffix, milliseconds (.123), missing timezone offset.
errorMessage: GrpHdr/CreDtTm has an invalid datetime format. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (no Z, no milliseconds).
fix: Replace with a valid ISO 8601 datetime. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 (e.g. 2026-06-09T10:00:00+00:00). Never use 'Z' suffix or milliseconds.

name: PACS003_AppHdr_CreDt_Format_Invalid
description: AppHdr/CreDt contains an invalid datetime. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Z suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.
errorMessage: AppHdr/CreDt has an invalid datetime format. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (no Z, no milliseconds).
fix: Replace with a valid ISO 8601 datetime with timezone. Example: 2026-06-09T10:00:00+00:00.

name: PACS003_Character_Set_Usage
description: All text values must comply with the CBPR+ permitted character set. Standard fields: A-Z a-z 0-9 space /\-?:().,'+. Extended fields (Nm, Adr, RmtInf): additionally !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\]. Use < for < and > for >.
expression: all(re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9 /\-?:().,\'+]*$', str(v)) for k, v in DATA.items() if isinstance(v, str) and not k.endswith('@Ccy') and not k.endswith('@Tp') and not re.search(r'(IBAN|BIC|LEI|UETR|MsgId|BizMsgIdr|CreDtTm|IntrBkSttlmDt|Nm|AdrLine|StrtNm|TwnNm|Ustrd|AddtlInf)', k))
errorMessage: Character set used does not comply with CBPR+ UHB specifications. Only A-Z a-z 0-9 space and /\-?:().,\' are permitted in standard fields. Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields allow extended charset including !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\].
fix: Remove characters outside the CBPR+ permitted set. For Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields use the extended charset. Replace < with < and > with >.
